propositions: Provider-prefixed model refs (anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6, openai:gpt-5.4) cause genai_prices.calc_price to raise LookupError, silently dropping usage rows from cost totals with no warning
The LookupError is caught and converted to unpriced status without logging, making pricing failures indistinguishable from genuinely unknown models

Bedrock-prefixed refs resolve successfully while Anthropic and OpenAI refs fail, creating an asymmetric bias that makes Bedrock appear more expensive in provider cost comparisons when it is simply the only provider being measured
The model_ref passed to genai_prices must be translated from provider-qualified form to bare form using registry membership, not prefix matching or string splitting
Pricing must remain best-effort and never break summarize output, but unpriced calls must be visibly named in output rather than silently dropped
